about: Marketing and growth log for Pep Shop Texas. Claude adds what was done each week; the Thursday report (pst-weekly) reads entries dated within the week and the 'next' list.

entries.title: Gold Standard lab reports live on product pages
entries.detail: A 'Verified by Gold Standard' box with every test result, read live from the lab. Trust is the #1 reason buyers pick a peptide shop.

entries.title: Gold Standard lab connected in the owner app
entries.detail: Order tests from the app; certificates attach to the right product by item #.

entries.title: Vial picture options (Jimmie's report #15)
entries.detail: Clear 3/5/10ml or amber 10ml, powder or liquid, four fill colors.

entries.title: SEO audit of pepshoptexas.com
entries.detail: Found product pages Google can't index (they all point to one page), no product data for search results, a stale sitemap, and no content pages. Fixes start next week.
